text.description_html:
Michael Healy MHS31, Bay Scallop Front Door Knocker in Brass

The Polished Brass Bay Scallop Door Knocker is stunning with an attention to detail that only a Michael Healy design could accomplish. The Polished Brass and Brown Patina finish highlights these details and adds a bit of glamor to the piece, making it ideal for any beach house. It is easy to install and comes with the necessary hardware to surface mount it on either wood or metal doors. The Bay Scallop Front Door Knocker in Brass comes packaged gift ready in a heavy duty box, making it a great choice for a housewarming gift.

Each door knocker is beautifully packed and is signed and dated by the artist, Michael Healy.

Available in 3 finishes:
Polished Brass with Brown Patina Nickel Silver Oiled Bronze

Also Available: larger 5" Polished Brass Sea Scallop Door Knocker

Features and Specifications of the Polished Brass Bay Scallop Standard Door Knocker:

  • Material: Sandcast Brass
  • Finish: Polished Brass with Brown Patina
  • Height: 3-7/10"
  • Width: 3-9/10"
  • Mounting Hole Centers: 2-3/10"
  • Projection Off Door: 1-1/2"
  • Mounting: Surface Mounting
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
